correctness.rationale: The exact interval verifier was read line by line. Its rational preconditioner has nonzero determinant; six face families are exhaustively covered by rational interval arithmetic with alternating Taylor enclosures on a domain where sine monotonicity is valid, giving strict Poincare--Miranda signs and hence an equilibrium. Whole-box interval bounds give characteristic coefficients \(a_1>0\), \(a_2>0\), \(a_3<0\); Descartes gives exactly one positive real eigenvalue and the remaining pair has negative real part. Independent floating-point root finding places a zero at approximately \((1.00372322,0.74723700,-0.39348247)\) with eigenvalues about \(1.80657\) and \(-4.27135\pm9.67923i\), corroborating but not replacing the interval proof.
